author: Claude Schlagenhauf
text: I want to thank them for coming out late and the additional help of getting a plumber to fix our backed up and clod lines. Very friendly

author: Coupe
text: I am so glad I called M & K. I can’t recommend them enough! They came out after 5pm in the rain. Mr. Shelton and his right hand man, Elijah were so helpful and made me feel so comfortable. I will call them for anything else I might need. Thank you gentlemen so much!!

author: Cristy Huffman
text: Thank you, M & K. I'd definitely call them again if I need anything and highly recommend them!

author: Ashley Shelton
text: HONEST, quick and reliable! I won’t use anyone else!

author: Julie Cordora
text: I'd give these guys 10 stars if I could! Not only did they come out on the same day due to a septic emergency, but they  worked until 930 pm to get it resolved and also made a suggestion that would save us money in the future. I most definitely recommend using them!
